annotations.title: Remote jobs by where you can work

description: Remote jobs from company career boards, filtered by the countries, regions or time zone the employer accepts: title, company, remote type, eligible countries and regions, seniority, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Billed per job returned.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

keywords.description: Optional title keywords, e.g. "backend", "product designer". Empty = all remote jobs.

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (default 14).

regions.description: Optional: e.g. Europe, EMEA, LATAM, North America.

seniority.description: Optional: e.g. JUNIOR, MID, SENIOR, LEAD.

worker_countries.description: Optional: only jobs open to workers in these countries (ISO codes or names, or EU).

worker_timezone.description: Optional: your UTC offset, e.g. UTC-6 or +5:30; keeps jobs within 3 hours.

name: remote_jobs
title: Remote jobs by where you can work
